name: clipboard
description: High-performance Win32 native clipboard manager. Get current clipboard text, set clipboard text, or instantly paste multiline text/code via Ctrl+V without dropped characters.

action.description: Clipboard action: 'get' text, 'set' text, or 'paste' text via simulated Ctrl+V.

restore.description: If true during paste, restores previous clipboard content after pasting.

text.description: Text to set or paste (required for action='set' or 'paste').
